The order of C + C spanned by its units, Z[1, i, j, ij] = {(z1, z2) in Z[i]^2 : z1 = z2 (mod 2)}, has index 4 in Z[i]^2 and 8 units (the extension group C_4 x C_2 of the table); Z[i]^2 is the maximal order, with 16 units (C_4 x C_4). (ii) The bicomplex norm used is the full algebra norm (degree 4); the quaternion norm is the reduced norm (degree 2).
